reason: Honestly I'd maybe download it if a friend pushed it, but my class and club WhatsApp groups already tell me every deadline and exam change before any official notice does. Between fests, practice and club meetings I'm not going to open one more app every week, and I barely remember my college Microsoft login anyway.
objection: It's just the same official notices that already come to Outlook, which I ignore, and the WhatsApp groups get the news faster and tell me what actually matters. Clubs and events, the part I'd care about, is only coming later.
would_change_my_mind: If it had all the club and fest stuff from day one, like event registrations, practice schedules and fest updates, so my whole extracurricular life was in it and not just exam notices.
